cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Answer the Previous Question
cards.instruction: Redirect every dangerous question by sincerely answering an earlier, safer version of it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. About the weather you asked earlier: yes, it rained all evening.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I asked why you crashed my car.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. And before that you asked whether the roads were wet. They were.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The forecast said showers. I should answer that original question completely.

mechanism: Copy a driver's stopping gesture without understanding the controls, then sincerely return to an earlier weather question whenever B asks about the resulting crash.
confusable: Not any evasive answer: the earlier safe weather inquiry must be explicitly established and reused under each new dangerous question.
comparison: A damaged car and rain observations rather than birthday cake and lunch review.
seedUse: Retains wet-road question as safe fallback; adds copied hazard-light gesture mistaken for slowing.
